# Plant Care — a watering log for my houseplants

I keep about twenty houseplants and forget which ones need water. I want a small web app for myself (no logins).

- **Plants**: a name, the species, where it stands (living room, kitchen, balcony…), how often it needs water
  (every N days), and an optional photo note.
- **Waterings**: each time I water a plant I log the date and an optional note ("added fertiliser").
- I want to see at a glance how many plants need water today and how many waterings I did this week.

Start with three plants: Monstera (living room, every 7 days), Basil (kitchen, every 2 days) and Fern (bathroom,
every 4 days).
